traits.name: Wrath of Spurned Hospitality
traits.text: A nyktera whose hospitality is betrayed becomes enraged at the violation of a fundamental aspect of their fey nature. They must succeed at a DC 20 Will save or begin involuntarily attacking the traitor. At the end of each of their turns, if they choose, they can attempt another Will save to end the effect; otherwise, the effect lasts until the traitor is subdued or leaves the nyktera's presence. As long as their righteous fury lasts, the nyktera gains a +2 status bonus to attack and damage rolls for their fist Strikes.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ fist +7 (agile, finesse, magical); Damage 1d6-3 (1d6-3) bludgeoning damage
